title: Asthma Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use an ICS-containing regimen rather than SABA-only treatment for persistent asthma.
Escalate stepwise therapy based on symptom control, exacerbation burden, and inhaler technique.
Review trigger exposure, inhaler technique, and adherence before intensifying therapy.

contraindications.label: pregnancy
contraindications.reason: Prefer pregnancy-compatible inhaled corticosteroid choices and avoid unnecessary regimen instability during pregnancy.

title: COPD Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Prioritize smoking cessation, vaccination, and inhaled bronchodilator therapy based on symptom and exacerbation burden.
Use LAMA or LABA maintenance therapy and escalate to combination therapy when symptoms or exacerbations persist.
Assess for pulmonary rehabilitation and oxygen needs when functional limitation or hypoxemia is present.

contraindications.label: narrow_angle_glaucoma
contraindications.reason: Use inhaled anticholinergics cautiously when narrow-angle glaucoma is present.

title: Heart Failure Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use guideline-directed medical therapy with RAAS blockade, beta-blocker, and SGLT2 therapy when clinically appropriate.
Avoid NSAID exposure and monitor fluid status, renal function, and potassium during medication titration.
Escalate quickly when congestion, hypotension, or rapid weight gain suggests decompensation.

contraindications.label: pregnancy
contraindications.reason: Avoid ACE inhibitors and ARBs in pregnancy and use pregnancy-safe alternatives.

contraindications.label: hyperkalemia
contraindications.reason: RAAS-directed therapy can worsen hyperkalemia and requires closer monitoring.

medication_warnings.message: NSAIDs can worsen heart failure control and should be avoided when possible.
